component.name: WorkerTask
component.script:
' The port is created once, in init(); the docs say only the first launched thread receives it. sub init() m.top.functionName = "work" m.port = CreateObject("roMessagePort") m.top.observeField("cmd", m.port) m.runs = 0 m.list = [1, 2] m.timer = CreateObject("roTimespan") end sub
sub work() m.runs++ line = "run " + m.runs.toStr() + ": port=" + type(m.port) + " list=" + type(m.list) + " timespan=" + type(m.timer) if type(m.port) = "roMessagePort" m.top.ready = true msg = wait(2000, m.port) line = line + " event=" + type(msg) end if print "TASK " + line m.top.report = line end sub
